description.narrative: The project#s development objective (PDO) is to promote environmentally sustainable urban transport in India and to improve the usage of environment-friendly transport modes through demonstration projects in selected cities.

The project's development objective (PDO) is to promote environmentally Sustainable Urban Transport in India and to improve the usage of environment-friendly transport modes through demonstration projects in selected cities. There are two components to the project. The first component of the project is providing technical assistance to the Ministry of Urban Development (MoUD) to improve the national, state and local capacity to implement the capacity building elements and the public- and non-motorized-transport- related aspects of National Urban Transport Policy. The second component of the project is supporting design and implementation of demonstration projects in six selected cities (in five participating states), which will create models of sustainable transport solutions for other Indian cities to replicate. The six cities, selected by government of India (GOI) through a competitive selection process, include Pune and Pimpri-Chinchwad (in Maharashtra), Naya Raipur (in Chhattisgarh), Jalandhar (in Punjab), Indore (in Madhya Pradesh), and Mysore (in Karnataka). The International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) loan will finance activities under the component two in three project cities (Pune, Pimpri-Chinchwad, and Naya Raipur). A Global Environment Facility (GEF) grant (being processed under a separate GEF project) will be used to finance component one and technical assistance activities of component two in all six cities.

title.narrative: NAYA RAIPUR - Atleast two public transport corridors are established and in operation between Naya Raipur and Raipur

comment.narrative: This target was achieved. Public transport was planned on both corridors connecting the old and new city, one is connected through the high performance BRTS Lite and the other through ordinary bus service.

title.narrative: NAYA RAIPUR - Safe sidewalks and cycle tracks are provided on the main roads of Naya Raipur

comment.narrative: 68 km of footpath and cycle tracks have been built under the project in Naya Raipur. The city has taken this forward by building many more kilometers through its own funds.

title.narrative: ITS systems and units are installed, functioning, and utilized at Mysore for at least 80% of their intended of revenue vehicle kilometers of service by project end.

comment.narrative: Overachieved. The system in Mysore is successfully operating and being utilized to improve the overall system performance. It is considered a success story in India and a role model for other cities, and received many awards.

title.narrative: ITS systems and units are installed, functioning, and utilized at Indore for at least 80% of their intended of revenue vehicle kilometers of service by project end.

comment.narrative: Overachieved. Though operationalized with some delays, the system is functional and has received positive feedback with regard to reduction in wait and travel time.

title.narrative: Pimpri-Chinchwad - Modal share by public transport increases

comment.narrative: Indicator is achieved. The public transport in the city has significantly improved and the mode shares have strengthened. The investment by the city in further BRT network development, the revival of the BRT in the twin city Pune, the development of non motorized transport networks and taking forward of the parking policy are all steps that will further strengthen mode shares.

title.narrative: Naya Raipur: Public transport trip mode share between Raipur and Naya Raipur increases

comment.narrative: Indicator is achieved. The launch of the interim bus service early on and the subsequent launch of the BRTS have ensured that a large proportion of trips between the old and new city are on public transport. Although the targets set were over-ambitious especially in the context of low public transport mode share in the old city as in other Indian cities, these have been overachieved with respct to the revised target and substantially achieved with respect to the original target.

title.narrative: Number of environmentally friendly urban transport practices and approaches provided by the project that are adopted by cities

comment.narrative: The indicator was surpassed. Several cities and agencies moved forward with sustainable approaches and practices on which they received support under the project either through LUTP training program or through the city specific support under Guidance Document preparation.

title.narrative: Pimpri-Chinchwad - At least two BRT Corridors operational

comment.narrative: PCMC currently has 3 of its 4 BRT corridors operational; and 1 of the 2 BRT corridors supported by the Bank. Corridor 4 which is complete is proposed for launch in April 2019 once the ordered buses arrive.

title.narrative: Forecast CO2 emissions over 10 years in the cities participating in Component 2 are at least 128,000 tons lower than BAU forecasts
Hubli-Dharwad - Public transport mode share increases

comment.narrative: This indicator is yet to be measured as the BRTS has recently commenced operations. However, the strong positive feedback of the users, the growing ridership and the initial surveys indicating that 18 percent of the users have shifted from personal modes of which 9 percent are from cars, provides ample evidence that the project is ensuring a shift towards more sustainable mode in the city.

title.narrative: HUBLI DHARWAD - Safe pedestrian access to BRT

target.value: Footpath, foot-over-bridges complete, traffic signals substantially installed

comment.narrative: Footpaths, foot-over-bridges and access at intersections have been provided for.

actual.value: Stations, footpath, FoB, traffic signal phasing in place

title.narrative: PIMPRI CHINCHWAD - Percentage of displaced families that are resettled in alternative houses
MoUD partners with states/cities to develop capacity and support cities in sustainable local solutions

comment.narrative: Indicator is overachieved. Officials participating in LUTP undertook 139 projects covering 47 cities and 20 plans were developed across 17 cities under Guidance Document city specific support in reform areas such as UMTA, UTF, ToD etc.

title.narrative: Number of environmentally friendly urban transport practices and approaches provided by the project that are adopted by cities

comment.narrative: The indicator was surpassed. Several cities and agencies moved forward with sustainable approaches and practices on which they received support under the project either through LUTP training program or through the city specific support under Guidance Document preparation.

title.narrative: Hubli Dharwad: Percentage of Project affected people received Compensation and Resettlement assistance.
HUBLI DHARWAD - BRT corridor is operational

comment.narrative: Achieved. The BRTS began trial runs in October 2018 and has gradually increased the service since then.

title.narrative: Mysore - PBS system installed and functioning

target.value: PBS launched on 4 June, 2017 and fully functioning

comment.narrative: PBS system became operational in June 2017becoming the first citywide system to be launched in India. The feedback has been extremely positive and it has informed the design and launch of other systems in the country.
